identity.decision: Elcho is the Perthshire castle locality in Rhynd parish, centred on Elcho Castle SM90140.
identity.evidence: Historic Environment Scotland designation record SM90140 records Elcho Castle in Rhynd parish.

geometry.decision: A tight, transparent castle-focused visitor-study polygon is used rather than claiming a parish or estate boundary.

score.rationale: The high-quality managed castle supports a short planned heritage stop; there is only one independently evidenced attraction and no separately verified food or trail offer.

dogs.decision: Pet dogs are not admitted to Elcho Castle; assistance dogs are excepted. Responsible-control guidance applies outdoors.
